_meta._comment: Arena rules — the 15 strategy agents trade each other on virtual accounts. This is a PAPER competition: it never places a broker order, it only moves numbers in its own account files. The governance ladder in strategy_levels.json is NOT touched by the arena; the arena keeps its own level counter so the live promotion rules (n>=10 over 14 days, 2 consecutive days) stay intact.

demote._comment: Demotion is deliberately hard to earn: five or more trades, a profit factor below 0.5 and a day that cost more than three times the risk budget. A level is a score, not a punishment — the race is the point. The first draft demoted on three trades and a PF under 0.7, which took three agents to level 0 on day one and made the ladder meaningless.

signal._comment: min_strength is the detector's own strength/confidence floor. 0 means every detector hit is taken — the arena is a competition, not the live book, so the live gates (LLM grading, session gates, weight gates, ticker bans) do not apply. Banned tickers in live_scan.py are ignored here on purpose: the user asked for all instruments, and the arena records the outcome per instrument so a ban can be judged on evidence instead of inherited.
